requirement.evidence: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord.
requirement.note: Landlord-use ban, definition (nonpublic data of two or more landlords), and tenant remedies including fees to prevailing tenant are all stated in §§98.1102-98.1104.

key_value.evidence: A tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation of this Division, in a civil action against a landlord.
key_value.note: The per-month and per-property separate violation language is in §98.1103: "For each month a violation of section 98.1103(b) exists or continues, and for each residential rental property a landlord uses an algorithmic device, it shall constitute a separate and distinct violation."

effective_date.evidence: (“Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing” added 5-22-2025 by O-21955 N.S.; effective 6-21-2025.)

status.evidence: (“Use and Sale of Algorithmic Devices Prohibited” added 5-22-2025 by O-21955 N.S.; effective 6-21-2025.)
status.note: Document presents the division as adopted current text, effective 2025-06-21, with no repeal or sunset; in force as of 2026-10-01.
